messages:
Jordan: quick check — onboarding rtx-3b-v2 model. Rahul where are the weights sitting? also noticed tokenizer splits emojis + — oddly in structured outputs. want a short smoke (golden prompts + toolcall) before we flip.

Rahul: weights in s3://redwood-models/onboard/rtx-3b-v2/weights.tar.gz
config in repo: infra/models/rtx-3b-v2.yaml
I ran a fast config-validator and it flags max_context: 4096 vs model expecting 2048 — likely why longer examples break.

Maya: saw the tokenizer quirk on a few examples: emojis get separate tokens which breaks our 'args' JSON in tool calls.
Example:

Input: "Pick emoji ✅ and call tool"
Tokens: ["Pick","emoji","✅","and","call","tool"]

Sophia: can we add a small tokenizer smoke script? e.g.

```
python tools/tokenizer_smoke.py --model /mnt/models/rtx-3b-v2 --cases tests/tokenizer_cases.json
```

It will assert token alignments for golden prompts.

Rahul: ran the golden prompt set quickly — majority pass, but tool-calling test 3 fails (malformed JSON param order). Log snippet:

```
[2025-06-03T14:52:10Z] ERROR: toolcall-parser: invalid JSON at offset 17
input: {"tool":"search","args":"{\"query\":\"nyc flights\"}"}
expected args to be parsed as JSON obj, got string
```

Jordan: thanks. sounds like two action items: (1) config -> set max_context to 4096 if we want longer prompts OR truncate/validate inputs; (2) fix tokenizer/toolcall glue.

Maya: I can prep a patch to tokenizer detokenize to keep emoji grouped, and add a test in infra/tokenizer_tests.

Rahul: I'll update infra/models/rtx-3b-v2.yaml to explicitly set tokenizer: "byte_level_emoji_v2" and run CI.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for infra/models/rtx-3b-v2.yaml (build #4521) — status: running

Sophia: also suggest adding a small runner to the golden-suite that does: (a) generation with streaming, (b) parse structured JSON output, (c) attempt tool call dry-run. Keeps regressions caught early.

Jordan: agree. owners:
- Maya: tokenizer patch + tests (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- Rahul: config update + CI run (ETA 2h)
- Sophia: golden-suite runner PR template + example cases (ETA EOD today)

Jordan: ping me when CI green + I'll schedule a canary onboard for Dedicated infra. :thumbsup:

Maya: noted. I'll post PR link when ready. (reacts :eyes:)

Rahul: CI green -> #1769254478

deploy-bot: CI pipeline build #4521 succeeded (12m) — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/4521/

Jordan: awesome, thanks team. I'll open a canary ticket and add the golden prompts set to the rollout checklist.
